approved_decision.rule: HNK has no approved universal default stress rule at this stage. Lexical stress is an explicit word-level property when governed. Forms without an approved stress value may be represented in broad unstressed/syllabic notation but must not be published as having a complete canonical stressed pronunciation.
approved_decision.rationale: No historical or governed global stress rule was recovered; lexical marking avoids inventing an unsupported universal rule while providing a controlled path to future pronunciation decisions.

governance_decisions.decision: Do not adopt fixed penultimate or fixed initial stress under this approval.
Permit broad unstressed/syllabic planning notation for words whose segmental nuclei are governed; for DAYI this may be recorded as /da.y.i/ without a stress mark.
Do not claim a complete canonical stressed pronunciation for DAYI, SARADAYA, TAYOVAN, VAMATAYA or HOYU until their lexical stress is separately governed.
B4 does not change G16 romanization, DAYI semantics, HOYU semantics, morphology, grammar, productivity or curriculum slots.
After B4, B5 may address romanization coverage; word-specific stress assignments may be prepared as separate explicit decisions without retroactively claiming historical recovery.
